map_info.name: VFM_03_Motion
map_info.description: Keep the familiar PointBody, with matched visible radius, height and collision shape. Apply the same one-newton force for one second to 1, 2 and 4 kg spheres; read acceleration and the retained velocity after the push. The loaded trolley and push-box puzzle let the same relation become a task. Reconstruct only the equal-force comparison.
map_info.title: The push ends. Motion stays.
